topic: Purpose and technical details of ADF
syllabus_extract: Purpose and technical details of ADF. Basic layout of intercom system in aircraft.
specific_objectives: 21.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the basic theory of communication.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of ADF indicator operation and Intercom panel layout; Safety: Ensure no loose items near equipment; Supervision: Instructor monitors trainee interaction with panel.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of the ADF system?
Name two types of radio navigation aids.
Define the basic theory of communication.

development.content:
Basic theory of communication
Purpose of ADF navigation
ADF technical details and components
ADF signal reception principles
ADF indicator operation

Basic layout of intercom system
Intercom panel components
Audio signal routing paths
Microphone and speaker locations
Intercom switch functions

ADF and Intercom integration
Troubleshooting common faults
Safety checks for radio equipment
Operational procedures review
Maintenance requirements overview

summary_questions: Explain how the ADF determines aircraft position relative to a station.
Describe the function of the intercom panel in the aircraft cabin.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the differences between ADF and VOR systems to be discussed in LP 09.

pft_rows.syllabus: Purpose and function of Altimeter and their types. Global positioning system (GPS) introduction, purpose airborne and space components of the system. Safety precautions to be observed whilst working on avionics systems
